title: Advertising
slide_intent: Teach how several posters can share a wall while each supplies a different message. At viewing distance the dominant words and images must carry the first read.
strategic_value: A mix of photography, questions and hand-drawn marks can let distinct campaign messages read as one public presence.
demonstration: A brick wall carries adjacent colored poster fields. A large question occupies the left group, while photographs, letters, illustrations and short statements fill the denser panels at right.
practical_value: Compare a text-led poster with a photo-led poster and decide which element should dominate each unit of a larger installation.

content_islands.name: Wall context and heading
content_islands.spec: Place the heading over the brick texture and keep the chapter navigation at the left edge.

content_islands.name: Poster run
content_islands.spec: Build a continuous band across the wall with a large green question panel, a cyan signature field and smaller photographic and illustrated panels. Retain visible boundaries between compositions.
